methods.doc: A memory-mapped array: the file's pages are the array's memory, so files larger than RAM can be processed. Modes as numpy.memmap: 'r', 'r+', 'w+', 'c'. Mapped bytes are not counted against memory_budget; info() reports them as memory_mapped. Both backends share libtessero's mapping code.

methods.name: load
methods.doc: Read a .npy file (numpy.load); with $mmapMode ('r', 'r+', 'c') it is memory-mapped instead.
